description: 20 live LLM scenarios probing deterministic-resolver precedence when a single message spans multiple question types (insulin, non-insulin drug cost, OOP/MOOP, pharmacy lookup, date/duration windows) or bundles multiple distinct questions in one prompt. Each deterministic resolver in navigator.py returns immediately on match, so a message that plausibly matches two resolvers risks silently dropping one half of the question. Not covered by mixed-basket (same-plan multi-drug baskets), insulin (insulin-only), or pharmacy-lookup (single-topic Q1-Q5 routing) suites, which each stay within one question category.
